🚨 Indian Rupee Hits All-Time Low

The Indian Rupee has crossed ₹94 against the US Dollar for the first time, marking a historic low. 📉

Over the decades, the rupee has steadily weakened — from around ₹3.30 per dollar in the 1950s to over ₹94 today. Factors like global market pressure, oil imports, inflation, and dollar strength continue to impact the currency.

A weaker rupee can make imports more expensive but may boost exports and IT services. The forex market will be closely watched in the coming months.
